اعلوطنا (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْنَا (iʕlawwaṭnā) /iʕ.law.watˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطْنَا (uʕluwwiṭnā) /uʕ.luw.witˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
